findings.subject: Recirculation package allocation
findings.observed: Available sheet lists P-205 A/B and M-201. Model has four branch packages; C/D pump identities and A/B/C/D mixer allocations remain proposed.

findings.subject: Feeder branch allocation
findings.observed: Sheet lists H-201/SF-201 and H-202/SF-202 without branch suffixes. Four modeled branch allocations remain proposed.

findings.subject: Document revisions
findings.observed: Register cites V5.1; inherited pilot cites V5.1.1. Available sheet has a placeholder XXX revision field and is Draft - Not for Use. No controlling approved revision established.

findings.subject: Temperature conflict
findings.observed: Available draft retains the 45–50 °C range and a separate ≤49 °C safety note. No setting selected.

findings.subject: Missing controlling A-400 source
findings.observed: The local temperature-sheet PDF skips FEED-PFD-0400. The inherited register page 9 is a full-document reference, not an available excerpt. No approved source revision is established.

findings.subject: Washing and membrane capacity
findings.observed: Model screening identifies an eight-module capacity shortfall and differing solids assumptions. Layout volumes, flux and module count are not qualified ratings.

findings.subject: Feed pump package arrangement
findings.observed: The model has two parallel trains of two feed-pump stages. Supplier drawing and utility-sheet pump counts remain unreconciled; no duty/standby allocation is asserted.

findings.subject: Permeate destination conflict
findings.observed: The model retains wastewater disposal; its inherited V17 workbook reference includes filter/RO recycle. No recycle connection is established by this expansion.

findings.subject: Cleaning, drains, vents and instrumentation
findings.observed: Cleaning chemistry, product isolation, vent compatibility, drain receiving pressure/invert, instrument tags and protective settings remain unqualified.

findings.subject: Cooler identity and construction conflict
findings.observed: Draft HX-501 is a shell-and-tube exchanger; model E-501 depicts a coil arrangement. E-501 remains the model-bound record; HX-501 is an unresolved source-tag candidate, not a second exchanger or approved alias.

findings.subject: Product routing and recirculation conflict
findings.observed: Draft sends cooler outlet toward A-600 with an optional 507 recycle to T-501. Model returns cooled slurry to T-501 and uses proposed P-502 for accepted-product transfer. These paths are not an approved operating sequence.

findings.subject: Sonication performance and feed basis
findings.observed: Three modeled cells, energy dose, residence time, flow, backpressure, cooling duty and product quality require trials/vendor selection. Draft 1-2 wt% and 30-40 degC targets are not approved setpoints or equipment ratings.

findings.subject: Draft-only source and optional features
findings.observed: Available sheet is Draft - Not for Use with revision XXX. Bypass is mentioned conceptually and degassing is suggested; neither is asserted as an installed or connected package. Draft says no added water or DMF for sonication.

findings.subject: Protection, controls and segregated services
findings.observed: Pressure/vacuum and relief sizing, cooling-loss response, acoustic protection, CIP isolation, sampling criteria, vent compatibility and drain receiving conditions remain unqualified.

findings.subject: Indicative temperatures conflict with TBD notes
findings.observed: Draft typical inlet 140-145 degC, outlet 80-90 degC and approximate product discharge 60-100 degC coexist with temperatures TBD. No operating or safety setpoint is selected.

findings.subject: Powder and exhaust destination reconciliation
findings.observed: Draft routes dryer output through F-601 to T-602; the model also has a direct DR-601 powder chute to T-602. Draft exhaust arrow calls for off-gas treatment, while its scrubber note mentions atmospheric discharge. Model retains an independent discharge boundary; neither a common treatment header nor permitted release is established.

findings.subject: Atomization, heat duty and product quality
findings.observed: Atomizer technology, evaporation duty, heating medium, gas flow/pressure budget, moisture target, capacities and materials remain unqualified. The model is aqueous; the draft scrubber solvent-vapor wording requires reconciliation and does not add a solvent-recovery system.

findings.subject: Gas choice, dust and pressure protection
findings.observed: Air is a draft/model concept. Gas selection, GO thermal stability, dust explosibility, grounding, dryer/filter protection, pressure limits and interlocks remain open. Conditional oxygen monitoring for inert drying is not an installed protective system.

findings.subject: Draft-only source, cleaning and service boundaries
findings.observed: Sheet is Draft - Not for Use with revision XXX. Wash compatibility, powder isolation, filter-media servicing, scrubber-liquor chemistry, drain receivers and gas-admission procedures require approval. No common process/thermal drain or cleaning sequence is authorized.

findings.subject: Pressure and oxygen protection unresolved
findings.observed: Draft +2 psig conflicts with slight negative pressure. Draft oxygen <10 ppm is an unqualified source claim, not an approved alarm, trip or operating limit. No pressure sign, oxygen threshold or permissive is selected.

findings.subject: Thermal duty and product acceptance
findings.observed: Draft approximately 1100 degC, 4 h hold and 5 degC/min ramp are indicative only. Gas cooling 60-90 degC and product cooling 60-80 degC require qualification. Capacities, materials, gas composition and argon demand are unknown.

findings.subject: Cooling and knockout arrangement conflict
findings.observed: Draft considers KO/dust trap upstream of E-701; model KO-701 is downstream. Draft internal cooling zone differs from model-added E-702. Draft prior-to-cyclone note has no identified drawn/model cyclone; no cyclone is invented.

findings.subject: Independent off-gas and emergency relief
findings.observed: Normal gas connects to AB-3701 candidate only; treatment performance and permitted discharge remain unqualified. Model RV-701 differs from draft PSV-701. Relief destination, sizing and backpressure remain open and separate from normal treatment.

findings.subject: Draft identity and transfer sequences
findings.observed: Draft is Not for Use with XXX revision. AR701/AR702 are draft stream identifiers, not confirmed equipment aliases for model AR-701. Air-fill dust vent and inert purge exhaust are distinct modes; purge, equalization, sampling and solids release sequences remain unqualified.

findings.subject: Drawn route and tag reconciliation
findings.observed: Draft arrows 806/807 show H-803 through RV-801 to PY-801, while General Note 2 names F-801. The concept follows the arrows; document-owner confirmation remains open. Draft AR801 identifies an argon stream, not an approved alias for the model AR-801 manifold.

findings.subject: Reaction, ratio and thermal basis unqualified
findings.observed: Draft 1 kg KBH4 per kg rGO, 750 degC, 5 degC/min ramp and 2 h residence are source references only. Draft +2 psig and maximum 10 ppm oxygen are not selected control or protective limits. Feed accuracy during refill, residence distribution, reaction/gas evolution, throughput and product acceptance remain open.

findings.subject: Dry reagent containment and cooling separation
findings.observed: TR-801 and LK-802 are model-added contained-transfer concepts. KBH4 handling remains dry and isolated from indirect cooling water; no process-water wash or common process/utility drain is inferred. Dew point, leakage, materials, capacities and residue handling are unqualified. RV-801 is not credited as positive isolation.

findings.subject: Separate exhaust, relief and missing cyclone context
findings.observed: PY-801 normal off-gas runs through E-801 and FN-801 to AB-3801 candidate. Inventory vents use DC-3811; F-802 has its own DC-3812 route. Emergency PSV-801 relief stays separate. The draft mentions a cyclone without an identified symbol/tag; no cyclone is invented. H2/boron composition, treatment performance, relief loads and final disposal remain unqualified.

findings.subject: Draft-only controls and downstream release
findings.observed: Sheet is Draft - Not for Use with XXX revision. Oxygen, moisture and hydrogen verification are functional concepts, not qualified sensors or trip logic. PY-801 includes heating, hold and cooling zones; no separate product cooler is invented. A-900 receiving equipment is not modeled. Product temperature, residual reactivity, quality and receiving atmosphere require acceptance.

findings.subject: Draft pH conflict and conditional chemistry
findings.observed: R-1002 draft targets conflict: 7-10.5 in stage text versus 8.5-10.5 by the reactor. R-1001 draft pH 3-4 is indicative only. BaCl2 polishing is conditional; the draft <1500 mg/L sulfate note is not a verified site discharge limit. HCl trim needs a metals-redissolution review. No dose or control target is approved.

findings.subject: Screening inventories are not equipment ratings
findings.observed: Model 100 m3/h, 15/30/20/20 min residence times, tank inventories and equalization assumptions are layout screening inputs, not measured flows or approved capacities. The model notes 62.208 m3/h eight-module A-400 capacity against a 71 m3/h duty. Upstream batch peaks, returns and actual chemistry remain unreconciled.

findings.subject: Bypass, recycle and RO acceptance
findings.observed: The draft permits conditional centrifuge bypass with downtime wording; the model keeps it closed and positively blinded. Downtime alone is not acceptance for A-2000. Centrate recycle improves solids capture only and does not remove dissolved salts. Residual Ba/Ca/sulfate, turbidity, pH and other RO acceptance criteria remain unqualified.

findings.subject: Vents, returns, drains and disposal remain qualified separately
findings.observed: Selected wet vents are candidate connections to HD-3100 only; chemical-storage vents remain separate by service. A-3000 condensate and blowdown returns are normally isolated. Low process drains are positively blinded; no common chemical drain or dry A-800 waste route is inferred. Sludge classification and receiving disposal acceptance require testing, not the draft non-hazardous wording.

findings.subject: Draft source, controls and service definition
findings.observed: Sheet is Draft - Not for Use with XXX revision. Cooling is a separate utility; duties and limits are unqualified. pH, temperature, level and mixing checks are functional concepts only. Legacy spare return connections remain capped; the modeled normal A-2000 backwash return is distinct. Aeration/oxidation remains future provision and is not invented as installed equipment.

findings.subject: Draft source and qualification
findings.observed: The sheet is Draft - Not for Use, revision XXX. Functional monitoring has no approved instrument tags, ranges or trip setpoints. Draft permeate quality targets are not measured performance or discharge permission. Conductivity alone does not verify all reuse criteria.

findings.subject: Model sizing and water balance
findings.observed: Model 100 m3/h feed, media 98%, UF 92.5%, 60% RO recovery and tank volumes are screening allowances, not ratings. Eight-hour inventory is a lower-end model selection within the draft 8-12 h recommendation. Base permeate is below the A-400 71 m3/h duty alone; supplemental water and batch balance remain unresolved.

findings.subject: Membrane and chemistry basis
findings.observed: Draft N+1 does not specify N; the model selects A/B duty and C standby with 72 elements per train and 8:4 staging in a single pass. Draft 70-75% higher recovery requires a scaling study. Residual Ba/Ca/sulfate, silica, oxidant breakthrough, greensand regeneration and antiscalant dose remain unqualified.

findings.subject: Segregated waste and cleaning
findings.observed: Normal media/UF backwash returns to A-1000. Brine and spent CIP have separate positively blinded boundaries with destinations unassigned. Sequential acid/alkaline CIP isolates one train from product and brine export. Low CIP drain needs contained pump-out; UF chemical CEB is an unmodeled hold with no active pipe.

findings.subject: Quality diversion and protection
findings.observed: Model off-spec permeate and stored water recycle to T-2001; no active off-spec drain is added from draft wording. Train C is modeled standby, not live state. Relief capacity/backpressure, tank vent qualification, pressure ratings and hygienic turnover remain open. Reclaimed water is not a potable emergency supply.

findings.subject: Source segregation and draft conflicts
findings.observed: The original Draft - Not for Use sheet joins wet/dry and furnace gases. P01 is a proposed NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION redraw, not approval. HD-3100 accepts candidate compatible wet vents only. Thermal/reactive gas, carbon/oxidizer dust, peroxide breathing, dryer vacuum exhaust and emergency relief remain separate. A-900 furnace wording conflicts with cartridge filling; no source is inferred.

findings.subject: Bypass and failure response
findings.observed: Original EX3003 operating bypass is deleted in the model/P01. Only a positively blinded stub remains, with no fan connection or operating stream. Loss of draft/liquor flow, high differential pressure or unqualified pH requires a reviewed response: inhibit new feed/heat, retain available residual-emission treatment, and do not blanket-close vessel vents. Fan stop is not vent isolation.

findings.subject: Unqualified gas load and performance
findings.observed: Model 5000 Nm3/h, 40 C, 3500 Pa drop, 2 m tower diameter and 12 m stack height are screening/layout inputs, not ratings or approved limits. KO separation is not a fine-mist guarantee or cooling duty. ME-3150 fiber-bed duty, removal efficiency, pressure budget, corrosion/materials and stack dispersion/emission acceptance remain unqualified.

findings.subject: Liquid seals, segregation and receiving
findings.observed: Acidic KO condensate and alkaline high-salt blowdown have distinct normally isolated A-1000 returns. Neutralization does not remove dissolved salts before A-2000. Sealed liquid returns and dedicated dirty-side pressure balances require verification at minimum liquid level and maximum differential pressure. Fan/stack low drains remain separately blinded with no continuous drainage credit.

findings.subject: Supply, instruments and identity holds
findings.observed: Makeup water uses a proposed physical air gap and buffer/pump; supply is blinded, overflow goes to an unqualified local catch tray. NaOH breathing stays independent. T-3180 is retained despite TK-3180 wording in the original notes. P01 uses AIT-3180 for pH while the model uses pHT-3180 for pH and AIT-3180 for conductivity: no instrument tag is selected. pH, flow, level, pressure and other trip limits remain null; no live control or SIS is validated.

findings.subject: Treatment technology and performance remain open
findings.observed: AB-3701 is a proposed vendor-package envelope. The model describes a thermal-oxidation candidate, but the A-700 draft only sends cooled gas to off-gas treatment. No oxidation, catalytic, filtration or polishing technology is selected; no destruction or removal efficiency is credited.

findings.subject: Combustible and oxygen envelope is unqualified
findings.observed: The draft identifies possible CO, CO2, water vapour and trace hydrocarbons, while model screening also retains particulate. Normal, peak, upset and residual batch emissions, oxygen ingress and flammability remain unknown. Draft oxygen <10 ppm is a source-side statement, not an approved package setpoint.

findings.subject: Pressure control and failure response are unresolved
findings.observed: The draft conflicts between +2 psig and slight negative pressure. FN-701 coordination, package pressure drop, furnace vacuum limits, fan trip response, purge continuity and safe shutdown are not approved. Emergency relief remains on IF-A700-RELIEF with no normal-treatment credit.

findings.subject: Dedicated outlet is not a permitted discharge
findings.observed: ST-3702 is a proposed independent outlet. Stack height, velocity, sampling plane/access, condensate management, dispersion, pollutant limits and jurisdictional air authorization remain unqualified. The geometry does not establish an atmospheric discharge approval.

findings.subject: Service segregation and package definition
findings.observed: AB-3701 remains separate from HD-3100 wet-acid treatment, AB-3801 reactive A-800 gas, dry-dust packages and emergency relief. Closed analyzer returns and inert lock purge enter the A-700 treatment context, while air-fill dust returns to A-600 filtration. Materials, refractory/insulation, utilities, drainage, access and vendor internals remain open.

findings.subject: Reactive off-gas treatment and performance remain open
findings.observed: AB-3801 is a proposed specialist package envelope. The draft requires H2-safe handling plus particulate and trace-boron capture, but selects no combustion, catalytic, adsorption, filtration or polishing technology. No destruction, capture or emission performance is credited.

findings.subject: Hydrogen, oxygen and reactivity envelope is unqualified
findings.observed: The draft identifies H2 and trace boron species and requires hydrogen monitoring. Oxygen ingress, moisture, boron chemistry, particulate loading, normal and peak gas evolution, ignition sources and residual batch reactivity remain unknown. Draft maximum 10 ppm oxygen is not an approved package setpoint.

findings.subject: Pressure control and failure response are unresolved
findings.observed: FN-801 and AB-3801 pressure drop, draft +2 psig source statement, furnace pressure limits, fan or purge failure response, isolation and safe shutdown are not approved. PSV-801 emergency relief remains independent on IF-A800-RELIEF with no normal-treatment credit.

findings.subject: Dedicated reactive-gas outlet is not a permitted discharge
findings.observed: ST-3802 is a proposed independent outlet. Stack height, velocity, sampling access, condensate or solids management, dispersion, pollutant limits and jurisdictional authorization remain unqualified. Geometry does not establish an atmospheric discharge approval.

findings.subject: DC-3811 inventory dust service remains unqualified
findings.observed: DC-3811 receives modeled dry vents from TR-801, H-801, H-802, F-801, MX-801, H-803 and LK-802. Each branch requires simultaneous-load, dust/reactivity, purge and pressure qualification. Collection media, cleaning method, containment, secondary treatment and final outlet are unselected.

findings.subject: DC-3812 borohydride feeder service remains isolated
findings.observed: F-802 uses the separate DC-3812 route because KBH4 dust may be water-reactive and may evolve H2. No generic water wash or air-pulse cleaning is assumed. The modeled outlet remains positively blinded until compatible downstream abatement and safe disposal are designed.

findings.subject: Treatment services remain segregated
findings.observed: AB-3801, DC-3811 and DC-3812 remain separate from HD-3100 wet-acid treatment, AB-3701 thermal service, E-801 reactive residue and emergency relief. No dry-package operating outlet stream is created because both modeled package outlets are blinded connection holds.

findings.subject: Rated thermal duties and simultaneous demand
findings.observed: No approved peak/normal loads, batch simultaneity, exchanger UA or fouling basis is indexed.

findings.subject: Hydraulic and mechanical design
findings.observed: Flow, pressure, pressure loss, NPSH, relief, expansion volume and equipment ratings remain unapproved.

findings.subject: Temperature basis
findings.observed: Draft ranges are 80–95/60–80 °C HW, 25–30/35–40 °C CW and 5–7/10–15 °C CHW; illustrated values are not operating setpoints.

findings.subject: Secondary-loop separation
findings.observed: Four TCUs use heat-transfer barriers; media, pressure hierarchy, leak detection and contamination response are unresolved.

findings.subject: R-201 cooldown margin
findings.observed: The 10 °C process target is only 3–5 K above draft chilled-water supply across two heat-transfer barriers.

findings.subject: Availability and safeguards
findings.observed: A/B pump geometry does not establish 2 × 100% capacity; shared systems receive no emergency-cooling credit.

findings.subject: HX-601 heating medium
findings.observed: HX-601 remains isolated and unassigned; draft hot water cannot provide the cited 140–145 °C dryer inlet by ordinary heat exchange.

findings.subject: Cooling-tower auxiliaries
findings.observed: Spray-water makeup, treatment, blowdown and winterization remain separate unresolved systems.

findings.subject: Controls and live state
findings.observed: CP-5000 is indication intent only; I/O, trips, setpoints and validated live data are absent.

findings.subject: Emergency-water source and topology
findings.observed: Dedicated potable, tempered source, treatment, storage and distribution topology are undefined; no common header is established.

findings.subject: Hydraulic capacity and duration
findings.observed: Station flow, pressure, simultaneous demand, duration, pipe sizing and residual pressure are unverified.

findings.subject: Temperature and winter protection
findings.observed: Tempering, delivered temperature, heat tracing, insulation, freeze protection and cold-weather availability are unresolved.

findings.subject: Backflow and isolation
findings.observed: Backflow prevention, branch isolation, test connections, dead-leg control and maintenance bypass are unresolved.

findings.subject: Runoff segregation and capacity
findings.observed: Compatible runoff destinations and capacity are unresolved; no reactive-spill, wastewater or storm connection is claimed.

findings.subject: Coverage and same-level access
findings.observed: Locations are planning reservations; exposure points, walking time, actuator reach and elevated-work coverage remain unapproved.

findings.subject: Selection and commissioning
findings.observed: Supplier selection, spray pattern, hands-free operation, signage, training, tests and commissioning are unavailable.

findings.subject: Common-service ownership
findings.observed: Battery limits, utility ownership, isolation and interfaces with A-4000/A-5000/A-6000 argon remain unresolved.

findings.subject: Equipment capacities and ratings
findings.observed: Approved R-101, T-102 and H-101/SF-101 datasheets are unavailable.

findings.subject: Materials and corrosion basis
findings.observed: Materials of construction, linings, corrosion allowance and compatibility are unapproved.

findings.subject: Controls and safeguards
findings.observed: P&ID tags, alarm/trip setpoints, relief basis and permissives are unavailable.

findings.subject: Recipe and batch basis
findings.observed: Graphite/acid quantities, addition rates, mixing time and acceptance criteria are unresolved.

findings.subject: Containment and transfer details
findings.observed: Charging, dust control, acid unloading, drainage and spill-recovery details require approval.

findings.subject: Source revision status
findings.observed: FEED-PFD-0100 remains a draft basis and requires reconciliation with approved project documents.

findings.subject: Reactor capacities and ratings
findings.observed: Approved R-141A/B/C/D datasheets and working volumes are unavailable.

findings.subject: Materials and corrosion basis
findings.observed: Reactor, charging and transfer materials and compatibility are unapproved.

findings.subject: Controls and safeguards
findings.observed: Temperature, pressure, feed, agitation, relief and interlock details are unresolved.

findings.subject: Recipe and parallel allocation
findings.observed: Premix, K2S2O8 and P2O5 quantities, addition sequence and branch allocation are unresolved.

findings.subject: Shared charging-package definition
findings.observed: CH-141/CH-142 count, branch ownership, dust control and isolation require approved design.

findings.subject: Source revision status
findings.observed: FEED-PFD-0140 remains a draft basis and requires reconciliation with approved project documents.

findings.subject: Equipment capacities and ratings
findings.observed: Approved tank, filter, dryer, transfer and vacuum-package datasheets are unavailable.

findings.subject: Materials and corrosion basis
findings.observed: Materials, filter media, seals, trays and product-contact finishes are unapproved.

findings.subject: Controls and safeguards
findings.observed: P&ID tags, sequences, alarms, trips, relief and vacuum safeguards are unresolved.

findings.subject: Filtration and drying performance
findings.observed: Wash endpoint, filtration cycle, cake moisture and dryer endpoint are unresolved.

findings.subject: Baseline versus alternatives
findings.observed: Only the baseline FEED arrangement is promoted; dryer, enclosed and integrated layouts remain mutually exclusive design studies.

findings.subject: Interface qualification
findings.observed: RO water, wastewater, vent, condensate, thermal and dry-product battery limits require approved sources.

findings.subject: Missing approved A-900 source package
findings.observed: No approved PFD, P&ID, equipment list, vendor package or operating narrative is available.

findings.subject: Product acceptance and short transfer technology
findings.observed: Temperature, quality, residual reactivity, receiving atmosphere, transfer mechanism and receiver capacity are unresolved.

findings.subject: Argon consumers and demand
findings.observed: AR-901/902/903 remain positively blinded reservations; no branch is selected or operating.

findings.subject: Dust and exhaust destination
findings.observed: DC-901 is a local functional envelope with an independent unresolved outlet; no treatment or permitted release is asserted.

findings.subject: Pelletization, finishing and release criteria
findings.observed: Pellet formulation, formation method, size/strength, cooling, classification, package format, containment, cleaning and reject criteria are unresolved.

findings.subject: Protection and operability basis
findings.observed: Combustible-dust properties, ignition protection, inerting acceptance, ergonomics, maintenance and recovery procedures are unapproved. Equipment skids and frames are provisional; vendor loads, structural member sizing, anchorage and vibration isolation remain unverified.
